2 10-07-2025 Heard the parties.

2. The present writ petition has been preferred for the following relief(s):
Yogendra Thakur vs The State Of Bihar on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/82974678/
1 (i) For issuance of a writ of mandamus directing the Respondents Patna High Court CWJC No.10758 of 2025(2) dt.10-07-2025 forthwith to cease all activities on the Petitioner's land and restore possession to the Petitioners and to restrain the respondents, their agents, subordinates, or any person acting on their behalf, from taking possession of, or carrying out any construction or development activity on, the land of the Petitioners, pending the final disposal of this writ petition.

entities.text: Yogendra Thakur vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The land in question is situated under Mauza -Basadh @ Vaishali and specifically includes the Khata Nos. 197 & 1952, Khesara Nos. 5721 and 5725, measuring 41 dismils and 32 dismils, Khata Nos. 2445 & 2368, Khesara Nos.
5719 and 5720, measuring 15 dismils and 13 dismils, Khata No. 2023, Khesara No. 5723, measuring 10 dismils on the ground that the Respondents have illegally acquired the said land without issuing any prior notice to the Petitioners and without payment of any compensation till date.

(ii) For issuance of an appropriate writ, order, or direction in the nature of Mandamus, directing the Respondents to make payment of compensation to the Petitioners for the land acquired considering the correct classification, nature, actual use, and prevailing market value of the said land, along with applicable interest and solatium as per law.

Patna High Court CWJC No.10758 of 2025(2) dt.10-07-2025 (iii) Pass such other and further orders as this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper in the interest of justice.
3. The matter relates to:
The land in question which is situated under Mauza -Basadh @ Vaishali and specifically includes the Khata Nos. 197 & 1952, Khesara Nos. 5721 and 5725,
measuring 41 dismils and 32 dismils, Khata Nos. 2445 & 2368, Khesara Nos. 5719 and 5720, measuring 15 dismils and 13 dismils, Khata No. 2023, Khesara No. 5723,
measuring 10 dismils.
4. The matter relates to construction of National Highway- 139(W) and the petitioners claim that though their lands are also being taken, no compensation amount has been extended.

6. In case, the petitioners approach separately/individually along with the relevant documents after hearing all the concerned parties, the respondent-Competent Authority-cum-Land Acquisition Officer, Vaishali is duty-bound to take the matter to its logical conclusion within a period of next four months.
7. If the petitioner(s) is/are entitled to the compensation, it goes without saying that the said process has to Patna High Court CWJC No.10758 of 2025(2) dt.10-07-2025 be completed at an earliest.
8. The writ petition is disposed of with aforesaid observation.
